name: Padma-Nathan 2008
question: Does nightly sildenafil after bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy improve unassisted erectile function after treatment ends?

design.population: Men with normal preoperative erectile function after bilateral nerve-sparing radical retropubic prostatectomy; 125 randomized, 123 treated, and 76 completed treatment and washout for efficacy analysis.
design.locator: Full text, Results and Table 1, pp 481-482 (125 randomized; Table 1 footnote identifies two randomized but untreated men)

verdictNote: Neither dose met Bonferroni alpha 0.025; the pooled completer comparison had P = 0.0156.
takeaway: After bilateral nerve-sparing prostatectomy, 125 men were randomized but only 76 completed assessment. Neither nightly sildenafil dose met the Bonferroni-adjusted primary comparison with placebo; a pooled completer analysis found spontaneous erectile function in 14/51 versus 1/25 (P = 0.0156).

reports.label: Nocturnal-erection subanalysis
reports.citation: McCullough AR, Levine LA, Padma-Nathan H. "Return of Nocturnal Erections and Erectile Function after Bilateral Nerve-sparing Radical Prostatectomy in Men Treated Nightly with Sildenafil Citrate: Subanalysis of a Longitudinal Randomized Double-blind Placebo-controlled Trial." *J Sex Med.* 2008;5(2):476-484. doi:10.1111/j.1743-6109.2007.00700.x
reports.followUp: 36 weeks of treatment followed by 8 weeks without ED treatment; assessment at postoperative week 48

results.endpoint: Duration of nocturnal penile rigidity at least 55%
results.measure: Penile-plethysmography outcome at the base and tip through postoperative week 48 in 54 completers

values.exp: 100 mg: week-48 base duration 36% and tip duration 65% of preoperative values
values.ctl: Little improvement from the postoperative week-4 nadir; week-48 percentage not stated in text

results.note: The paper reports descriptive trajectories without a formal treatment-group test. Tip rigidity at least 55% separated sildenafil responders from nonresponders more clearly than base rigidity.
results.locator: Full text, Efficacy Variables and Duration of Rigidity, p 479; Figures 1-2, pp 478, 480; Study Responders vs. Nonresponders, pp 480-481

results.endpoint: Unassisted erectile-function response in nocturnal-tumescence subset
results.measure: Postoperative week-48 unassisted erectile-function response after 8-week washout in 54 penile-plethysmography completers
results.note: Responder status followed the parent trial definition; this small subset was not subjected to rigorous statistical analysis.
results.locator: Full text, Study Responders vs. Nonresponders, p 480; Comment, p 481

delivery.label: Operative technique
delivery.value: Experienced surgeons used the standard Walsh open radical retropubic technique; bilateral nerve sparing was documented after surgery and checked against operative and pathology reports; no laparoscopic procedures were included.

reports.label: Primary report
reports.citation: Padma-Nathan H, McCullough AR, Levine LA, et al. "Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study of postoperative nightly sildenafil citrate for the prevention of erectile dysfunction after bilateral nerve-sparing radical prostatectomy." *Int J Impot Res.* 2008;20(5):479-486. doi:10.1038/ijir.2008.33
reports.followUp: 36 weeks of nightly treatment from postoperative week 4, then 8-week drug-free assessment at week 48
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Study design, p 480; Primary efficacy results, p 482

results.endpoint: Spontaneous erectile function by assigned dose
results.measure: Postoperative week-48 responder rate after 36 weeks of treatment and 8-week drug-free washout: combined IIEF questions 3 and 4 score at least 8 plus satisfactory-sexual-activity response; completer analysis

effect.p: 50 mg vs placebo: 0.04; 100 mg vs placebo: 0.03 (nominal Fisher exact P values)

results.note: The statistical plan specified pairwise dose-versus-placebo comparisons and Bonferroni adjustment after switching from CMH to Fisher exact testing. For two comparisons, adjusted alpha is 0.025; the Table 2 P values match unadjusted Fisher tests and neither dose reaches the adjusted threshold.
results.locator: Full text, Statistics, p 481; Primary efficacy results and Table 2, p 482

results.endpoint: Pooled spontaneous erectile function across sildenafil doses
results.measure: Postoperative week-48 responder rate after 8-week drug-free washout; pooled completer analysis
results.note: The pooled sildenafil comparison was reported in the abstract; the stated primary analysis plan used pairwise comparisons of each dose with placebo. No between-arm effect interval was reported.
results.locator: Full text, abstract, p 479 (exact P value); Statistics, p 481; Table 2, p 482

results.measure: End-of-study six-item Erectile Function domain score, mean ± SD (median), among completers
results.note: No between-arm P value is reported for this domain score.
results.locator: Full text, Secondary efficacy results: erectile function domain, p 482

harms.label: Any adverse event
harms.note: Headache: 6/40 (50 mg), 5/41 (100 mg), 3/42 (placebo); dyspepsia: 7/40, 7/41, 0/42; abnormal vision/chromatopsia: 2/40, 3/41, 0/42. Safety included everyone who took at least one dose.
harms.locator: Full text, Table 3 and Safety, pp 482-483

harms.label: Serious adverse event
harms.note: None of the six serious events was considered related to study drug.
harms.locator: Full text, Table 3 and Safety, pp 482-483

harms.label: Discontinuation due to adverse event
harms.note: Two 50-mg recipients discontinued for treatment-related events (fatigue, headache or dyspepsia); the other discontinuations were not described as treatment related.
harms.locator: Full text, Table 3 footnote b and Safety, pp 482-483

delivery.label: Treatment schedule
delivery.value: Computer-generated 1:1:1 randomization allocated fixed-dose sildenafil 50 mg, sildenafil 100 mg or matching placebo using double-dummy blister cards. Nightly treatment began 4 weeks after surgery, continued for 36 weeks, and was followed by 8 weeks without any ED treatment.

delivery.label: Premature closure
delivery.value: Of 238 screened, 125 were randomized, 123 took study drug, 82 completed 36 weeks of treatment, and 76 completed the 8-week drug-free assessment. Enrollment stopped after a blinded interim response of 9/35; 19 discontinuations were attributed to study closure.
delivery.locator: Full text, Statistics and Results, p 481; Results and Discussion, pp 482-483
